cases.sentence: Из хранилища ___ добрый человек выносит доброе, а злой человек выносит злое из хранилища зла.
cases.translation: Out of the treasury of good, a good man brings out good things, and an evil man brings out evil out of the treasury of evil.
cases.explain: Genitive of content/possession ('the treasury of good').

cases.sentence: Я дам ему духа моего, и он возвестит ___ правосудие.
cases.translation: I will put my Spirit on him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.
cases.explain: The verb возвестит (will proclaim to) takes its recipient in the dative case.

cases.translation: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating motion into a place takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.
cases.explain: The preposition над governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Или вы не читали в ___, что в субботу священники трудятся в храме?
cases.translation: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath the priests labor in the temple?
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating 'written in' takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Любое ___, разделившееся на враждующие части, приходит в запустение.
cases.translation: Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to ruin.
cases.explain: Царство is the grammatical subject of the verb приходит, so it stands in the nominative case.

reading.ru: Его ученики были голодны и начали срывать колосья и есть зерна.
reading.question: What did Jesus' disciples do on the Sabbath that upset the Pharisees?
options: They plucked heads of grain and ate them
reading.correct: They plucked heads of grain and ate them
reading.explain: The text says the disciples начали срывать колосья и есть зерна.

reading.ru: А ведь насколько человек дороже овцы? Стало быть, в субботу позволяется делать добро.
reading.question: What did Jesus conclude about doing good on the Sabbath?
options: It is lawful to do good on the Sabbath
It is forbidden to do good on the Sabbath
Only priests may do good on the Sabbath
Good deeds must wait until Sunday
reading.correct: It is lawful to do good on the Sabbath
reading.explain: Jesus concludes в субботу позволяется делать добро.

reading.ru: Фарисеи же, выйдя, стали совещаться о том, как им убить Иисуса.
reading.question: What did the Pharisees begin to plan after Jesus healed the man's hand?
reading.explain: The text says the Pharisees стали совещаться о том, как им убить Иисуса.

reading.ru: Вот мой избранный слуга, возлюбленный мой, и в ком радость души моей
reading.question: How does the prophecy of Isaiah, quoted in this chapter, describe God's chosen servant?
options: As beloved, in whom God's soul delights
As a stranger from a foreign land
reading.correct: As beloved, in whom God's soul delights
reading.explain: The quoted prophecy calls the servant возлюбленный мой, и в ком радость души моей.

reading.ru: Все люди удивлялись и спрашивали друг друга. Может, это и есть сын Давидов?
reading.question: What did the crowds wonder after Jesus healed the blind and mute man?
options: Whether Jesus could be the son of David
Whether Jesus was a Roman soldier
reading.correct: Whether Jesus could be the son of David
reading.explain: The people ask each other Может, это и есть сын Давидов?

reading.ru: Он изгоняет демонов не иначе, как силой Вильзевула, повелителя демонов
reading.question: What accusation did the Pharisees make against Jesus?
options: That he cast out demons by the power of Beelzebul
That he was possessed by demons himself
That he stole from the temple treasury
That he broke the Sabbath law deliberately
reading.correct: That he cast out demons by the power of Beelzebul
reading.explain: The Pharisees claim Jesus casts out demons силой Вильзевула, повелителя демонов.

reading.ru: Но если я изгоняю демонов Духом Божиим, то это значит, что Царство Божие пришло к вам.
reading.question: What did Jesus say it means if he casts out demons by the Spirit of God?
options: That the Kingdom of God has come to them
That he is greater than Beelzebul only
That demons are more powerful than God
reading.correct: That the Kingdom of God has come to them
reading.explain: Jesus says casting out demons by God's Spirit means Царство Божие пришло к вам.

reading.ru: Но кто говорит против Святого Духа, тот не будет прощен, ни в этом веке, ни в будущем.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about speaking against the Holy Spirit?
options: It will never be forgiven, in this age or the age to come
It is a minor sin easily forgiven
It can be forgiven through fasting
reading.correct: It will never be forgiven, in this age or the age to come
reading.explain: Jesus says such a person не будет прощен, ни в этом веке, ни в будущем.

reading.ru: Из хранилища добра добрый человек выносит доброе, а злой человек выносит злое из хранилища зла.
reading.question: What analogy does Jesus use to describe good and evil people?
options: A good person brings good things out of a good treasury, and an evil person brings evil out of an evil one
Good people are like fertile fields and evil people like deserts
Good people speak softly while evil people shout
Good people are rich and evil people are poor
reading.correct: A good person brings good things out of a good treasury, and an evil person brings evil out of an evil one
reading.explain: Jesus describes the good man bringing good из хранилища добра and the evil man bringing evil из хранилища зла.

reading.ru: кроме знамения пророка Ионы. И как Иона был три дня и три ночи в желудке огромной рыбы, так и Сын Человеческий будет в сердце земли три дня и три ночи.
reading.question: What sign did Jesus say would be given to that generation?
options: The sign of the prophet Jonah
A sign written in the sky
A sign performed in the temple
reading.correct: The sign of the prophet Jonah
reading.explain: Jesus says no sign will be given кроме знамения пророка Ионы, comparing Jonah's three days in the fish to his own three days.

reading.ru: Тогда он идет, берет с собой семь других духов, еще более злых, чем он сам, и они приходят и поселяются там.
reading.question: What does the unclean spirit do when it returns to its old house and finds it empty?
options: It brings seven other spirits more evil than itself to live there
It leaves permanently, never to return
It brings one weaker spirit to help clean the house
It transforms into a good spirit
reading.correct: It brings seven other spirits more evil than itself to live there
reading.explain: The text says the spirit берет с собой семь других духов, еще более злых, чем он сам.

reading.ru: Вот моя мать и мои братья, потому что кто исполняет волю моего небесного Отца, тот мне и брат, и сестра, и мать
reading.question: Whom did Jesus identify as his true mother and brothers?
options: Whoever does the will of his heavenly Father
reading.correct: Whoever does the will of his heavenly Father
reading.explain: Jesus says whoever does the Father's will тот мне и брат, и сестра, и мать.
